elements.description: The conversation list: search, pinning, folders, rename and delete with Undo, grouped by date; windowed.

properties.name: folders
properties.description: Folders, in the order they show; chats name theirs with `folder`

properties.name: now
properties.description: "Now" for the date groups (epoch ms or a Date). Unset: the time the element was connected

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the tree's name

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: Height of the list before it scrolls, in px

properties.name: undoFor
properties.description:
How long Undo stays after a delete, in ms. It waits while the pointer or focus is on it and starts over after;
`Infinity` keeps it until the next delete (WCAG 2.2.1)

properties.name: hints
properties.description: Show the keyboard hints (hints="false" hides them)

properties.name: locale
properties.description: Locale for the month names; unset uses the page's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A chat was opened (click, Enter); detail `{ value: string | null }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-conversations-change
events.description: The list changed (renamed, pinned, moved, deleted, restored); detail `{ conversations }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `conversations`

events.name: tc-rename
events.description: A chat was renamed; detail `{ id, title }`

events.name: tc-pin
events.description: A chat was pinned or unpinned; detail `{ id, pinned }`

events.name: tc-move
events.description: A chat was moved to a folder, or out of one (`folder: null`); detail `{ id, folder }`

events.name: tc-delete
events.description: A chat was deleted (Undo may still bring it back); detail `{ id, conversation }`

events.name: tc-restore
events.description: Undo brought a deleted chat back; detail `{ id, conversation }`

props.name: conversations
props.description: Every conversation. Controlled when defined; otherwise the list keeps them, starting at `defaultConversations`

props.name: defaultConversations
props.description: The starting list when `conversations` is not controlled

props.name: onConversationsChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after any change (rename, pin, move, delete, Undo)

props.name: value
props.description: The open chat's id. Controlled when defined (null for none)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The chat open at first, when `value` is not controlled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the id of the chat that was opened

props.name: title
props.description: The heading above the list, and the tree's name (default "Chats")

props.name: onRename
props.description: Called when a chat is renamed in place, with its new title

props.name: onPin
props.description: Called when a chat is pinned or unpinned

props.name: onMove
props.description: Called when a chat is moved to a folder, or out of one (null)

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called when a chat is deleted – Undo may still bring it back (onRestore)

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Called when Undo brings a deleted chat back

props.name: onNewChat
props.description: Called when New chat is pressed

changelog: `tc-chat-history` – conversations grouped by Pinned, folders, Today … month: search, rename in place (F2), pin, move, delete with undo, a context menu; the WAI-ARIA tree pattern, windowed (10,000 chats render under 120 rows).
